jobs.title: Assistant Groups & Event Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description: Company DescriptionIn Zürich we offer you two exciting places to work: the 25hours Hotel Zürich West and Langstrasse. Both hotels tell their own story - as do our colleagues. Our ambience is multicultural, our philosophy is unconventional. We are a young team and love our first-name culture mixed with a good upbringing. Six meeting rooms, two restaurants, a bar - versatile possibilities to organize parties and events in the house. You make sure that all event rooms are sold and that every event runs smoothly.COME AS YOU ARE AND SHOW WHAT YOU CAN...... in a 4 day week.Enjoy 3 days off every week and the opportunity to make your free time more flexible.Job DescriptionHow does your working day looks like ...You’ll look after our event guests – working closely with your team from early morning until lateYou’ll coordinate events with all internal departments and ensure that everyone has all the necessary informationYou’ll be responsible for translating menus and various event and sales documents (German/English)You will be responsible for all group enquiries for 8 rooms or moreYou will be responsible for preparing quotations, contracts and invoicesYou will prepare forecasts, reports and sales analysesYou will attend internal meetingsYou will act as the point of contact for the team in the manager’s absenceYou will draw up training and rota schedulesYou will actively maintain customer relationships and support sales activitiesYou will ensure compliance with hotel standards and quality assurance in the events departmentYou will enter bookings into the system, draw up rooming lists and prepare everything for a seamless check-in and stayYou conduct customer meetings on site and follow these up with telephone discussions.You organise tours of the premises for event and corporate clientsYou prepare for each shift and ensure that everything is tidied up afterwardsYou keep a clear overview, even when every room in the hotel is booked out and things are getting hecticQualificationsYour personality counts more than your CV...You have professional experience in a similar role and are a passionate hostYou are an open and communicative person who isn’t afraid to stand your ground when necessaryYou enjoy working with people and inspiring themYou are passionate about good food and drink and enjoy discovering new conceptsYou bring not only your skills but also your personality to the roleYou are fluent in German and EnglishAdditional InformationWhat`s in it for you...After successfully completing your probation period you have the opportunity to switch to a 4-day workweekStay up to 10 nights per year free of charge at our 25hours hotelsAs part of Ennismore, benefit from generous discounts at our bars, restaurants, and hotels worldwideYou’ll have the freedom to bring in your own ideas and experiment creativelyEnjoy attractive offers from our many cooperation partnersBe part of our colorful staff parties and vibrant tribe spirit

Accompanied by selected wines and aperitifs, this creates a lively atmosphere full of Mediterranean joie de vivre – spontaneous, sociable and relaxed.The RIBELLI team will ensure an unforgettable and authentic experience and is looking forward to meeting you!COME AS YOU ARE & SHOW WHAT YOU CAN … … in a 4-day-workweek.Enjoy 3 days off every week and the opportunity to organize your free time more flexible!Job DescriptionHow does your working day look like...You take care of smooth processes, clean tables and workplaces, so that you can work hand in hand as a team - even if all guests come at the same time.You enjoy working with people and taking care of the well-being of others.As a trained gastronome you never run out of things to do and conjure up the wow in the guest's faceQualificationsYour personality counts more than your CV...You already have several years of experience in the service industryYou are enthusiastic about good food and drinks and like to discover new conceptsYou do not only bring your skills, but also your characterAdditional InformationWhat`s in it for you...Get to know all the other 25hours Hotels and stay for free for a maximum of 10 nights per year as a employee Get an extra allowance for travelling by public transport and take advantage of fantastic offers from our cooperative partners!Take advantage of being a part of Ennismore and get generous discounts when visiting our bars and restaurants as well as booking hotel rooms all over the world Benefits from great offers from our numeros cooperations partnersReconcile your personal situation with work - we are open to parttime employments and other adjustmentsBe part of our hilarous staff parties and much more...

jobs.description: Description de l'entrepriseNous sommes bien plus qu’un leader mondial. Nous sommes plus de 250 000 femmes et hommes à partager quelque chose d’unique chaque jour, nous accueillons le monde. Nous veillons sur des millions d’hôtes. La curiosité est ce qui nous anime, tout comme l’attention à l’autre. Nous aimons le mélange des cultures. Nous partageons des valeurs fortes : passion pour le client, performance durable, esprit de conquête, innovation, confiance et respect.Nous sommes fiers de nos différences. Oui, nous sommes des pionniers – Et nous allons toujours plus loin avec audace, avec imagination, avec passion.Le Novotel Genève Centre, un établissement 4 étoiles niché au cœur de Genève, offre 206 chambres élégantes, un restaurant et un bar convivial, un centre de fitness bien équipé et 5 salons dédiés aux conférences ou séminaires. Complétant cette offre, la Résidence, propose 30 studios situés juste derrière le Novotel. Notre équipe, travaillant pour ces deux entités, assurent ainsi un service de qualité et une expérience mémorable à nos clients.Description du posteAu sein du Novotel Genève Centre, la mission principale du poste est l’assistance à la comptabilité générale et administrative de l'hôtel.Comptabilité :Contrôle et traitement de factures fournisseursPréparation des paiementsSuivi des contratsProvisions de fin de moisContrôle quotidien des caissesToutes autres tâches comptables confiées selon la motivation de la personneAdministration :Apporter du soutien au département des Ressources HumainesGestion des uniformes (distribution, suivi des stocks et renouvellement)Assurer le suivi des dossiers administratifs du personnel Indiquer impérativement vos critères de motivation et d'adéquation avec le posteQualificationsConnaissance et experience dans le milieu hôtelier est un plusMaitrise des outils informatiques (Excel, logiciels comptables) indispensablePolyvalence, bon esprit d'équipe, organisation, rigueur, sens des priorité et autonomieMaîtrise du français et anglais professionnelInformations supplémentairesNotre engagement en faveur de la diversité et de l'inclusion : Nous sommes une entreprise inclusive et notre ambition est d'attirer, de recruter et de promouvoir des talents divers.

descriptionByLocale.it: Descrizione aziendaleSiamo molto più di un leader mondiale. Siamo più di 250.000 donne e uomini per condividere qualcosa di unico ogni giorno, accogliamo il mondo. Guardiamo oltre milioni di ospiti. La curiosità è ciò che ci ispira, proprio come l'attenzione all'altro. Ci piace il mix di culture. Condividiamo valori forti: passione per il cliente, performance sostenibili, spirito di conquista, innovazione, fiducia e rispetto. Siamo orgogliosi delle nostre differenze. Sì, siamo pionieri – E andiamo sempre più audacemente, con immaginazione, con passione. Situato nel cuore di Ginevra, il Novotel Genève Centre offre 206 camere eleganti, un accogliente ristorante e un bar, un centro fitness ben attrezzato e 5 sale conferenze e seminari. Completando questa offerta, il Residence offre 30 monolocali situati proprio dietro Novotel. Il nostro team, lavorando per queste due entità, assicura un servizio di qualità e un'esperienza memorabile per i nostri clienti. Descrizione della posizione All'interno del Novotel Geneva Centre, la missione principale del post è di assistere nella contabilità generale e amministrativa dell'hotel. Responsabilità:controllo e trattamento dei fornitori di fatturePreparazione dei pagamentiContrattosentenze finanziarie Controllo giornaliero di caisse Tutte le altre attività contabili affidate secondo la motivazione della personaAmministrazione: Sostenere il Dipartimento delle Risorse Umane Gestione dell'Uniformità (distribuzione, monitoraggio dell'inventario e rinnovo) Assicurare il follow-up dei registri amministrativi del personale È imperativo indicare i vostri criteri di motivazione e di idoneità con la posizioneQualificheLa conoscenza e l'esperienza nell'ambiente dell'hotel è un piùConsapevolezza degli strumenti IT (Excel, software contabile) indispensabiliPolivalenza, buon spirito di squadra, organizzazione, rigore, senso di priorità e autonomiaProfessional English e French managementUlteriori informazioni Il nostro impegno per la diversità e l'inclusione: Siamo una società inclusiva e la nostra ambizione è di attrarre, reclutare e promuovere diversi talenti.
descriptionByLocale.en: Company descriptionWe are much more than a world leader. We are more than 250,000 women and men to share something unique every day, we welcome the world. We watch over millions of guests. Curiosity is what inspires us, just like attention to the other. We like the mix of cultures. We share strong values: passion for the customer, sustainable performance, spirit of conquest, innovation, trust and respect.We are proud of our differences. Yes, we are pioneers – And we go ever further boldly, with imagination, with passion. Novotel Genève Centre, a 4-star hotel nestled in the heart of Geneva, offers 206 elegant rooms, a friendly restaurant and bar, a well-equipped fitness centre and 5 conference and seminar rooms. Complementing this offer, the Residence offers 30 studios located just behind Novotel. Our team, working for these two entities, thus ensure a quality service and a memorable experience for our customers. Description of the position Within Novotel Geneva Centre, the main mission of the post is to assist in the general and administrative accounting of the hotel.Accountability:Control and processing of invoices suppliersPreparation of paymentsFollow-up of contractsEnd-of-month provisionsDaily control of caissesAll other accounting tasks entrusted according to the motivation of the personAdministration:Supporting the Department of Human ResourcesUniformity management (distribution, inventory tracking and renewal)Ensuring the follow-up of staff administrative records Is it imperative to indicate your criteria for motivation and suitability with the positionQualificationsKnowledge and experience in the hotel environment is a moreAwareness of IT tools (Excel, accounting software) indispensablePolyvalence, good team spirit, organization, rigour, sense of priority and autonomyProfessional English and French managementAdditional informationOur commitment to diversity and inclusion: We are an inclusive company and our ambition is to attract, recruit and promote diverse talent.
descriptionByLocale.de: UnternehmensbeschreibungWir sind viel mehr als ein Weltmarktführer. Wir sind mehr als 250.000 Frauen und Männer, um jeden Tag etwas Einzigartiges zu teilen, wir begrüßen die Welt. Wir beobachten Millionen von Gästen. Neugier ist das, was uns inspiriert, genauso wie die Aufmerksamkeit für den anderen. Wir mögen die Mischung der Kulturen. Wir teilen starke Werte: Leidenschaft für den Kunden, nachhaltige Leistung, Eroberungsgeist, Innovation, Vertrauen und Respekt. Wir sind stolz auf unsere Unterschiede. Ja, wir sind Pioniere – Und wir gehen immer weiter mutig, mit Phantasie, mit Leidenschaft. Das Novotel Genève Centre, ein 4-Sterne-Hotel im Herzen von Genf, bietet 206 elegante Zimmer, ein freundliches Restaurant und eine Bar, ein gut ausgestattetes Fitnesscenter sowie 5 Konferenz- und Seminarräume. Ergänzend zu diesem Angebot bietet die Residence 30 Studios direkt hinter Novotel. Unser Team, das für diese beiden Unternehmen arbeitet, gewährleistet somit einen qualitativ hochwertigen Service und ein unvergessliches Erlebnis für unsere Kunden. Beschreibung der Position Im Novotel Geneva Centre besteht die Hauptaufgabe der Post darin, die allgemeine und administrative Buchhaltung des Hotels zu unterstützen. Rechenschaftspflicht: Kontrolle und Verarbeitung von Rechnungen LieferantenVorbereitung von ZahlungenNachfolge von VerträgenEnd-of-Monat Bestimmungen Tägliche Kontrolle von CaissesAlle anderen nach der Motivation der Person anvertrauten BuchhaltungsaufgabenVerwaltung:Unterstützung der Abteilung Human ResourcesUniformity Management (Verteilung, Bestandsverfolgung und Erneuerung) Gewährleistung der Weiterverfolgung der Verwaltungsunterlagen des Personals Ist es zwingend notwendig, Ihre Kriterien für Motivation und Eignung mit der PositionQualificationsKnowledge und Erfahrung in der Hotelumgebung ist ein mehrBewusstsein für IT-Tools (Excel, Buchhaltungssoftware) unverzichtbarPolyvalenz, guter Teamgeist, Organisation, Strenge, Sinn für Priorität und AutonomieProfessionelles englisches und französisches ManagementZusätzliche Informationen Unser Engagement für Diversität und Inklusion: Wir sind ein integratives Unternehmen und unser Ziel ist es, verschiedene Talente zu gewinnen, zu rekrutieren und zu fördern.
